description: When I think about Queens, I see a vibrant, diverse community where every voice matters. But what about the voices of those who cannot speak for themselves—our animals? Animal welfare in Queens is not just a side issue; it’s a critical part of building a compassionate, thriving neighborhood. I’m here to break down how animal welfare policies are shaping Queens and why they should matter to you.Why Animal Welfare in Queens Demands Our AttentionAnimal welfare in Queens is more than just protecting
